records.title: Implementation of Parvatmala Pariyojana in Telangana
details: c to d: The NHLML has initiated the process for the appointment of consultant for the preparation of Detailed Project Report for three projects.

records.title: Upgradation and modernisation of runways
details: d: Runway upgradation/modernisation projects are currently underway at 13 airports of AAI.

records.title: Railway Projects in Telangana.
details: Indian Railways has planned to develop a Railway Manufacturing Unit at Kazipet, Telangana at a cost of cost of Rs.521.36 crore which will be capable of manufacturing and maintaining a variety of modern Rolling Stocks.

records.title: Promotion of Riverfront Religious Tourist Destinations.
details:
(e): The Ministry of Tourism has sanctioned a project “Development of
Gopalpur, Barkul, Satapada and Tampara” in Odisha under the Coastal
Circuit of the Swadesh Darshan Scheme, to promote tourism along the
coastal belt and includes major components such as road development,
tourist reception centres, jetties, water sports equipment, cruise boats,
etc.

records.title: India - Middle East - Europe Economic Corridor
details: (a) to (c): Further, the Union Cabinet approved the development of a new Major Greenfield Port at Vadhavan in Maharashtra with an estimated project cost of Rs.76,220 Crores. The Vadhavan port has a natural draft of 20 meters and a cumulative capacity of 298 Million Metric Tons (MMT) per annum, catering the requirement to handle mega size new generation vessels. Also, the Virtual Trade Corridor (VTC) under the framework agreement between India and UAE on the IMEEC has been soft launched.
